correctness.rationale: For every fixed c>0, the clipped cyclic logistic map is analytic near interior homogeneous fixed point q=1-1/r. Fourier diagonalization gives multipliers 1-t and 1-t±iκt (κ=sqrt(3)c,t=r-1), unit-circle crossing exactly at r_c=1+2/(1+κ²)<3, transverse outward derivative one, and a third multiplier strictly within unit disk at r_c. The exact quadratic Fourier equations give center-manifold U=-(2r_c/t_c)|Z|²+O(|Z|³); outside resonances c=1/3,1/sqrt(3), eliminating the conjugate-square term with p=β/(barλ²-λ) yields l1=Re(barλ[γ+2βbar p])=-(κ²+3)^3/(1+κ²)^2<0. Independent SymPy algebra recomputed p, l1 and c=1 value -27/2; numerical crossing and exact Fourier substitution checks from the inspected package were distinguished from proof. The nonresonant Neimark–Sacker theorem and transverse contraction then give a nearby attracting invariant Jordan curve for sufficiently small r-r_c>0. Clipping is inactive near onset; no global basin or resonant circle assertion.

value.rationale: A balanced three-site directed logistic ring is the smallest circulation network with a nontrivial oscillatory Fourier pair. The exact onset before the scalar flip and universally negative first Lyapunov coefficient across every positive nonresonant coupling resolve the nonlinear bifurcation type rather than just reporting linear instability. The sharp all-coupling sign and attracting-circle conclusion constitute a motivated structural dynamical classification.
